blocks.x: New Digital Ventures & Product Incubation composes Dataq Compass, Dataq Forge — platforms with documented controls and evidence packs, so governance is part of the runtime. The pattern is in delivery now in Technology & SaaS, Banking & Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Manufacturing & Industrial.

New Digital Ventures & Product Incubation runs on phases: phase one prices the problem in your own units and signs the baseline; phase two designs with the risk envelope written down; phase three proves a bounded slice on your data; phase four scales what survived the gate. The engagement is instrumented like production, because it is production: gates, named owners, and a weekly cadence your control owner can forward. For New Digital Ventures & Product Incubation, that discipline is not optional — it is the engagement model.
